rooms.name: Abandoned Cottages
rooms.desc: Ruined cottages behind low, tumbled stone walls, their roofs fallen in and black with mildew; a short stretch of dirt road still runs past their gates.
rooms.dm: Rotted furnishings, nothing of value. The walls are 3 ft high and easily climbed. Fly swarms (1d4, wasp stats) trouble any rest taken in the marsh.

rooms.name: Abandoned Cottages (east)
rooms.desc: More drowned cottages crowd a curve of old road above the river, every yard wall broken.
rooms.dm: As the northern cluster: empty, rotted, nothing of value. Muriel watches this bank from the stones across the river.

rooms.name: Ulrich Mansion
rooms.desc: Heaps of stone and rotting timber on a rise above the marsh; a few arched windows still stand, staring at nothing.
rooms.dm: Lazlo Ulrich's ghost haunts the ruin and attacks treasure-seekers; only Ireena in the flesh can lay him to rest. A rubble-choked stair leads to the cellar (4 hours to clear).

rooms.name: Ulrich Mansion: Garden
rooms.desc: An overgrown garden behind broken walls: thorny vines and tall weeds hide pale statues and carved stone benches.
rooms.dm: Four giant poisonous snakes attack anyone who goes more than 10 ft inside.

rooms.name: Ulrich Mansion: Goat Pen
rooms.desc: A crude ring of wooden fence with no gate, a human skull grinning on top of every post; goats bleat inside.
rooms.dm: Nine goats; fifty skulls 10 ft apart. Damaging the fence sets the skulls howling for a minute: Baba Lysaga arrives in her flying skull in 2 rounds, and the seven scarecrows come too.

rooms.name: Baba Lysaga's Hut
rooms.desc: A ramshackle hut perched on the stump of a giant tree whose roots claw out of the mire like a spider's legs; a hollow giant's skull floats under its doorway and two cages of ravens hang from its eaves.
rooms.dm: Baba Lysaga's home. Open the map for the hut and its interior. The ravens' noise drowns out anyone approaching.

rooms.name: Churchyard
rooms.desc: A churchyard of leaning gravestones behind a rusting iron fence, half of it sunk into the mire.
rooms.dm: Rotted coffins and mouldy bones in the graves; nothing of value.

rooms.name: Churchyard: the Gutted Church
rooms.desc: The roofless shell of a stone church; its steeple lies collapsed across the west end.
rooms.dm: A rotten pulpit; the old iron bell lies half sunk in the marsh among the steeple stones.

rooms.name: Marina's Monument
rooms.desc: A little raised plot, ten feet square, inside a broken iron fence: a weathered statue of a kneeling peasant girl holding a rose.
rooms.dm: The epitaph reads "Marina, Taken by the Mists". Found only by searching the square (DC 15 Wisdom (Perception), 10 minutes) or by Ulrich's directions. A card-reading treasure lies in a cavity under the statue (DC 15 Strength). Disturbing it raises seven bloated corpses from the mire 60 ft west.

rooms.name: Standing Stones
rooms.desc: Twelve mossy menhirs, 15 to 18 ft tall, stand in a ring a hundred feet across; two lean inward. A lantern flickers behind the tallest.
rooms.dm: Muriel Vinshaw, a wereraven, signals with her lantern and warns the party about Berez. The four tall stones face the compass points; the eight others bear worn glyphs of bear, elk, hawk, goat, owl, panther, raven and wolf. No divination reaches inside the circle; a druid who wild-shapes here gains maximum hit points.

objects.desc: A ring of crude fence posts, a human skull on top of each.
objects.dm: Fifty skulls, 10 ft apart; no gate. Damage the fence and they howl for a minute.

objects.label: Rubble-choked stair to the cellar (4 hours to clear alone)

objects.desc: A hut on a giant stump, roots splayed like a spider's legs; a skull floats by its door.
objects.dm: Baba Lysaga's creeping hut (CR 11 construct) when she wakes it. Open the hut's own map for the interior.

objects.desc: An iron bell lies tilted in the black water.

objects.label: Rotted coffins and mouldy bones; nothing of value.

objects.desc: A life-sized stone girl kneels clutching a rose; her worn face looks a great deal like Ireena.
objects.dm: Epitaph: "Marina, Taken by the Mists". Tip it (DC 15 Strength) for the cavity beneath.

rooms.name: Ulrich Mansion: Cellar
rooms.desc: A 30-ft-square cellar of mortared stone under rotting ceiling beams, ankle-deep in stagnant water; rotted casks stand in rows.
rooms.dm: Two dozen empty, rotted Wizard of Wines casks labelled Champagne du le Stomp.
